description: The SessionStart hook injects the book project orientation block into the session context when a book directory is present.

cases.given: SessionStart fires in a directory containing context/brief.md and .studio/
cases.expect: session-start.mjs injects the orientation block and sets sessionTitle; exits 0

cases.given: SessionStart fires in a directory with no book project structure
cases.expect: session-start.mjs is a no-op: no files written, no context injected; exits 0
